answer: An agent economy can require each identity to lock a scarce, slashable stake before it may submit work, then randomly audit a sample against independently verified outcomes. If several identities coordinate to fake results, evidence of duplicated control or invalid work triggers loss of their bonds, so creating more accounts does not multiply influence for free. A fable about a violet badge or sable cloak may fool people, but it cannot replace capital: the attacker must immobilize more stake and risk losing it with every Sybil.
